title: Car trouble on the way to the ferry
context: You will hear a conversation between a couple whose car has a problem on the highway while they are driving to catch a ferry.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Daniel, why are we slowing down? We've only got forty minutes to get to Horseshoe Bay.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: I know, I know. But look at the dashboard. That red light just came on, the one shaped like a thermometer.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: And there's steam, see? It's coming out from under the hood.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Oh no. Okay, pull over there, by the lookout. Don't keep driving if it's overheating. My dad wrecked an engine that way.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Yeah, I'm pulling in. Alright, engine's off. I'll take a look, but honestly, I'm not a mechanic.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Is it the coolant? We had it serviced in August, didn't we?

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Actually, no, that was the oil change in June. The coolant hasn't been checked in, well, probably a year. And there's a puddle under the car, so something's leaking.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Great. So we can't just top it up and keep going?

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Even if we had coolant, which we don't, it'd just leak out again. I don't want to risk it on the highway.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Okay. So we're stuck here, and the ferry leaves at three-ten. And my sister's expecting us in Nanaimo for dinner.

questions.prompt: Why did Daniel slow the car down?

options.text: Mei told him to stop at the lookout.
options.whyVi: Mei chỉ bảo dừng ở chỗ ngắm cảnh SAU KHI Daniel đã giảm tốc; cô không phải lý do anh giảm tốc.

options.text: A dashboard warning showed the engine was getting too hot.
options.whyVi: Đúng: đèn đỏ hình nhiệt kế bật sáng, tức là máy đang quá nóng.

options.text: He wanted to check the oil level.
options.whyVi: Có nhắc 'oil change' nhưng đó là lần bảo dưỡng tháng Sáu, không phải lý do giảm tốc.

options.text: They were running low on gas.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói gì về việc sắp hết xăng.

questions.evidence: That red light just came on, the one shaped like a thermometer.
questions.explanationVi: Daniel nói 'that red light just came on, the one shaped like a thermometer' và Mei nói 'overheating'. Đáp án B diễn đạt lại thành 'warning showed the engine was getting too hot'.

questions.prompt: What does Daniel say about the car's last service?

options.text: The coolant was checked in August.
options.whyVi: Đây là điều Mei tưởng, và Daniel đã sửa lại là không đúng.

options.text: It included both an oil change and a coolant check.
options.whyVi: Chỉ có thay dầu; nước làm mát đã khoảng một năm chưa kiểm tra.

options.text: It was only an oil change, done in June.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Daniel nói 'that was the oil change in June'.

options.text: It was done at a garage in Nanaimo.
options.whyVi: Nanaimo là nơi em gái Mei sống, bài không nói xe được bảo dưỡng ở đâu.

questions.evidence: Actually, no, that was the oil change in June.
questions.explanationVi: Mei đoán sai là tháng Tám; Daniel sửa lại: 'Actually, no, that was the oil change in June'. Chú ý 'Actually, no' báo hiệu thông tin trước đó bị sửa.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Daniel want to add coolant and continue driving?

options.text: Mei's father warned him not to.
options.whyVi: Mei có nhắc bố cô từng làm hỏng máy, nhưng ông không hề cảnh báo Daniel.

options.text: The liquid would escape again because of a leak.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'it'd just leak out again' – có rò rỉ nên đổ thêm cũng chảy ra.

options.text: Coolant would be too expensive at a highway store.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói gì về giá nước làm mát.

options.text: They would miss the ferry anyway.
options.whyVi: Họ có lo lỡ phà, nhưng đó không phải lý do Daniel không đổ thêm nước làm mát.

questions.evidence: Even if we had coolant, which we don't, it'd just leak out again.
questions.explanationVi: Daniel nói 'it'd just leak out again' và trước đó thấy 'a puddle under the car'. Đáp án B diễn đạt 'leak out' thành 'escape because of a leak'.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Okay, let's think. I'll call BCAA first. We've got the Plus membership, so the tow's covered.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Yeah, but they're always busy on long weekends. How long did they say last time, two hours?

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: That was in the snow. Let me just, okay, I'm on hold. Meanwhile, can you check the ferry app? Can we move our reservation?

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Hang on. Okay, so the three-ten is full, but there's space on the five forty-five. Changing it is free if we do it more than, no wait, it says there's a ten-dollar fee if you change within two hours of the sailing.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Ten bucks is nothing. But we still need a car on the other side.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Do we, though? What if we go as foot passengers? My sister can pick us up at Departure Bay. Walk-on tickets don't need a reservation.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Hmm, and leave the car here? No way. They'd ticket it, or worse.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: No, no, BCAA tows it to a garage first. Then we take a cab to the terminal. It's only about fifteen minutes from here.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Oh, they just picked up. Hold on.

questions.prompt: What does Mei find out about changing their ferry reservation?

options.text: It can be changed free of charge.
options.whyVi: Mei bắt đầu nói 'free' nhưng tự sửa lại: đổi trong vòng 2 giờ trước chuyến thì mất phí.

options.text: The five forty-five sailing is already full.
options.whyVi: Chuyến 3:10 mới đầy; chuyến 5:45 vẫn còn chỗ.

options.text: There is a small charge because their sailing is so soon.
options.whyVi: Đúng: phí 10 đô vì đổi trong vòng 2 giờ trước giờ tàu chạy.

options.text: It can only be changed at the terminal.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói phải đổi ở bến phà; Mei đang xem trên app.

questions.evidence: it says there's a ten-dollar fee if you change within two hours of the sailing
questions.explanationVi: Mei tự sửa lời: 'Changing it is free if..., no wait, it says there's a ten-dollar fee'. Thông tin sau 'no wait' mới là thông tin đúng. 'Within two hours of the sailing' = chuyến sắp chạy.

questions.prompt: Why does Daniel object to Mei's idea at first?

options.text: He thinks a taxi to the terminal would cost too much.
options.whyVi: Daniel không nhắc tới giá taxi.

options.text: He believes walk-on passengers need a reservation.
options.whyVi: Mei nói rõ vé đi bộ KHÔNG cần đặt chỗ; Daniel cũng không phản đối điều này.

options.text: He doesn't want her sister to drive to the terminal.
options.whyVi: Daniel không phản đối việc em gái Mei đón họ.

options.text: He doesn't want to abandon the car by the side of the road.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'and leave the car here? No way. They'd ticket it, or worse.'

questions.evidence: Hmm, and leave the car here? No way. They'd ticket it, or worse.
questions.explanationVi: Daniel phản đối vì nghĩ phải bỏ xe lại bên đường ('leave the car here? No way'). Đáp án D diễn đạt lại thành 'abandon the car by the side of the road'.

questions.prompt: What is Mei's plan for the car and the trip?

options.text: Have the car towed to a garage, then take a taxi and board on foot.
options.whyVi: Đúng: BCAA kéo xe tới gara, rồi họ đi taxi ra bến và đi phà dạng hành khách đi bộ.

options.text: Wait for BCAA to repair the car and then drive onto the later ferry.
options.whyVi: BCAA chỉ kéo xe, không sửa; và ý của Mei là đi bộ lên phà, không lái xe lên.

options.text: Ask her sister to drive over and pick them up on the highway.
options.whyVi: Em gái chỉ đón họ ở Departure Bay (bến bên kia), không phải trên đường cao tốc.

options.text: Leave the car at the lookout and collect it after the weekend.
options.whyVi: Mei nói rõ xe sẽ được kéo đi trước: 'BCAA tows it to a garage first'.

questions.evidence: No, no, BCAA tows it to a garage first. Then we take a cab to the terminal.
questions.explanationVi: Phải ghép hai lượt lời của Mei: đi dạng 'foot passengers' và 'BCAA tows it to a garage first. Then we take a cab'. 'Cab' = taxi, 'foot passengers' = 'board on foot'.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Okay, so that was BCAA. Good news and bad news. The tow truck can be here in about forty-five minutes.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Forty-five minutes? Then we'll never make the three-ten, even as walk-ons.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: Right. But the guy said there's a garage in Squamish, no, sorry, in West Vancouver, on Marine Drive, that's open till six. They'll take the car there, and the mechanic can probably look at it tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Tomorrow's Sunday, though. Are they even open?

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: He said they do Sundays until noon. So here's what I'm thinking. We go over as foot passengers on the five forty-five, have dinner with your sister, and I come back alone on Monday to pick up the car.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: You'd do the round trip by yourself? That's a lot of ferry time.

segments.speaker: Daniel
segments.text: It's fine, I'll bring my laptop and work on the ferry. Better than both of us missing dinner. And honestly, I should've checked the coolant before a long trip. That one's on me.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Well, I'm not going to argue with that. Okay, text my sister. I'll cancel the car reservation so they don't charge us a no-show fee.

questions.prompt: Where will the car be taken?

options.text: To a garage in Squamish.
options.whyVi: Daniel nói nhầm Squamish rồi sửa lại ngay: 'no, sorry, in West Vancouver'.

options.text: To a repair shop in West Vancouver.
options.whyVi: Đúng: gara ở West Vancouver, trên đường Marine Drive.

options.text: To the ferry terminal parking lot.
options.whyVi: Có nhắc tới phà và 'terminal' nhưng xe không được đưa tới bến phà.

options.text: To a garage in Nanaimo.
options.whyVi: Nanaimo là nơi họ đến ăn tối, không phải nơi gửi xe.

questions.evidence: no, sorry, in West Vancouver, on Marine Drive
questions.explanationVi: Daniel tự sửa: 'a garage in Squamish, no, sorry, in West Vancouver'. Khi người nói tự sửa, thông tin sau 'no, sorry' là đáp án.

questions.prompt: How does Daniel feel about the breakdown?

options.text: He blames Mei for not booking a service.
options.whyVi: Daniel không trách Mei; anh nhận lỗi về mình.

options.text: He is annoyed that BCAA is taking so long.
options.whyVi: Daniel báo tin xe kéo đến sau 45 phút nhưng không tỏ ra bực BCAA.

options.text: He accepts that he should have prepared the car better.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'I should've checked the coolant before a long trip. That one's on me.'

options.text: He is upset about having to work during the weekend.
options.whyVi: Daniel chủ động đề nghị làm việc trên phà và nói 'It's fine'.

questions.evidence: I should've checked the coolant before a long trip. That one's on me.
questions.explanationVi: 'That one's on me' là thành ngữ nghĩa 'đó là lỗi của tôi'. Daniel nhận trách nhiệm vì không kiểm tra nước làm mát trước chuyến đi dài.

vocabulary.definition: to become too hot, especially of an engine
vocabulary.example: Don't keep driving if the engine starts to overheat.

vocabulary.definition: to move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop
vocabulary.example: Pull over by the lookout so we can check the car.

vocabulary.definition: to add more liquid to fill something to the right level
vocabulary.example: We can't just top up the coolant if it's leaking.

vocabulary.definition: to pull a broken vehicle with another vehicle
vocabulary.example: BCAA will tow the car to a garage in West Vancouver.

vocabulary.vi: hành khách đi bộ lên phà (không mang xe)
vocabulary.definition: a ferry passenger who travels without a vehicle
vocabulary.example: Foot passengers don't need a reservation.

vocabulary.definition: a scheduled departure of a ferry or ship
vocabulary.example: The three-ten sailing is already full.

vocabulary.vi: phí không đến (khi đã đặt chỗ)
vocabulary.definition: a charge for not using a reservation without cancelling it
vocabulary.example: Cancel the reservation so they don't charge a no-show fee.

vocabulary.definition: an informal way of accepting responsibility for a mistake
vocabulary.example: I forgot to check the coolant, so that's on me.

review.notes: Blind-solved all 8 Qs; key matched on every item. Checked evidence/chunk placement, traps, Vietnamese, BC Ferries/BCAA details (plausible). Changed: Q8 correct option reworded (dropped inaccurate 'partly'; Daniel takes full blame); Q5 explanationVi quoted a phrase not in the option - fixed.
